<#
.SYNOPSIS

    The gate results at the code head, appended to the task text.
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess)]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $GateSummary
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'CcPlugin.ps1')

Write-Output "Now: $((Get-Date).ToString('s'))"
$g = Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.todo.get' -Params ([ordered]@{ id = 'IMPL-UNITGREEN-001' })
$todo = Get-CcValue (Get-CcValue $g.Parsed 'payload') 'result'
$tasks = @(Get-CcValue $todo 'implementationTasks' | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })
if ($tasks.Count -ne 21) { throw "Expected 21 tasks, found $($tasks.Count)" }
if (@($tasks | Where-Object { [bool](Get-CcValue $_ 'done') }).Count -ne 0) { throw 'A task is checked; refusing.' }

$task22 = 'Round 6 fix of hostile validation round 5 (DISAGREE 97/96; R5-F1, R5-F2; operator 2026-10-21 "Fix both, strengthen ACs" and "Approve, strengthen AC-006/008 (Recommended)"; plan section 19). ' + $GateSummary + ' Awaiting hostile validation'
$updatedTasks = @(foreach ($task in $tasks) { [ordered]@{ task = [string](Get-CcValue $task 'task'); done = $false } }) + @(
    [ordered]@{ task = $task22; done = $false }
)
Write-Output ('BEFORE tasks={0}' -f $tasks.Count)
Write-Output ('AFTER  tasks={0} task22Length={1}' -f $updatedTasks.Count, $task22.Length)
if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess('IMPL-UNITGREEN-001', 'workflow.todo.update (append task 22)')) {
    $u = Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.todo.update' -Params ([ordered]@{
            id                  = 'IMPL-UNITGREEN-001'
            implementationTasks = $updatedTasks
        })
    Write-Output "todo.update exit=$($u.ExitCode)"
    if ($u.ExitCode -ne 0 -or $u.Raw -match '(?im)^\s*type:\s*error') { Write-Output $u.Raw; exit 1 }
    $r = Get-CcValue (Get-CcValue (Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.todo.get' -Params ([ordered]@{ id = 'IMPL-UNITGREEN-001' })).Parsed 'payload') 'result'
    $after = @(Get-CcValue $r 'implementationTasks' | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })

. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'CcPlugin.ps1')
